name: Mason County, WV
findings: Mason County has 67 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Mason County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Mason County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
